player_0.content: New plan: My previous attempt failed because I assigned a high score to "Excited" (6), which contradicts the character's defensive and sarcastic tone throughout the dialogue. Marcus is reacting to a personal jab about his reliability ("forgetting to show up") and immediately pivots to a competition to regain control, indicating he feels "Challenged" rather than genuinely happy or eager. In the future, I will strictly align the scores with the character's defensive posture: I will assign a very low score (0-1) to "Excited" to reflect his lack of genuine enthusiasm, keep "Humiliated" low as he deflects the insult, and ensure "Challenged" remains the dominant emotion with the highest score, accurately reflecting his acceptance of the bet as a counter-move.
